description: Validation harness that verifies SurrealDB primary storage with Redis cache-aside pattern
features: Mock Redis and SurrealDB clients for isolated testing
Operation timestamp tracking for write order verification
No LLM required - deterministic PASS/FAIL based on operation sequences

failures: Template Creation Write Order - Redis written without SurrealDB
Template Read Cold Cache - No SurrealDB fallback
Data Durability - Templates lost after Redis flush
Execution Recording Write Order - Redis updated before SurrealDB
Cache Invalidation - Cache not invalidated on updates
